title: Transport the normalized scalar mate to literal inverse-image coefficients
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism and $d$ an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Put $R_T=\widehat A_T$, $R_T^0$ its constant-system presentation, and $b_T:R_T^0\cong R_T$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Assume $c_f:f^{-1}R_Y\to R_X$ is invertible [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Choose arbitrary ring sheaves $S_Y,S_X$, maps $\varphi_T:R_T\to S_T$, and $c:f^{-1}S_Y\cong S_X$ satisfying $c_f;\varphi_X=f^{-1}(\varphi_Y);c$. Let $F^{ab},G^{ab}$ be additive ordinary functors equal to the canonical ringed direct images for these two coefficient identifications [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and write $F=R(F^{ab}),G=R(G^{ab})$. Let $U_T,E_T$ be exact restriction and derived extension along $\varphi_T$. Suppose $i:U_X^{ab};F^{ab}\cong G^{ab};U_Y^{ab}$ is identity on underlying sections, and $e:U_X;F\cong G;U_Y$ is normalized on every complex $C$ by $u_F(U_X C);F(\rho_X^{-1}(C));e_{QC}=Q(i_C);\rho_Y^{-1}(G^{\bullet}C);U_Y(u_G(C))$, with $u$ the universal derived units and $\rho$ the exact-restriction localization comparisons. Put $\chi=b_Y;\varphi_Y$, $K^0=\operatorname{Res}_{b_X}K$ and $K^i=\operatorname{Res}_{c_f^0}K^0$, for $K\in D(R_X)$, where $c_f^0:f^{-1}R_Y^0\cong R_X^0$ is the canonical completed coefficient identification [lemma-weil-pbc-perfect-projection-formula]. For literal inverse-image rings use $H_A=Rf_{*,A}$ and the canonical scalar mate $\beta_\chi:E_\chi H_{R_Y^0}\to H_{S_Y}E_{f^{-1}\chi}$ defined by the geometric counit [lem-sfb-derived-scalar-mate-thick-locus]. There are isomorphisms $s:\operatorname{Res}_{b_Y}U_YE_YF(K)\cong U_\chi E_\chi H_{R_Y^0}(K^i)$ and $t:\operatorname{Res}_{b_Y}U_YGE_X(K)\cong U_\chi H_{S_Y}E_{f^{-1}\chi}(K^i)$ such that $\operatorname{Res}_{b_Y}U_Y(\sigma_K);t=s;U_\chi(\beta_{\chi,K^i})$, where $\sigma_K$ is the $E_Y\dashv U_Y$ transpose of $F(\eta_X(K));e_{E_XK}$. This statement concerns only scalar and geometric adjunctions and asserts no tensor identification or invertibility of a projection.

proof.text: Prove the completed coefficient square by applying limit hom extensionality. At each quotient, the definition of completedFiniteCoefficientMap cancels the inverse of the constant-system comparison. This identifies the inverse-image source restriction with CompletedProjection.inverseObject.

Use exact coefficient restriction equivalences and inverse mates to construct the X and Y scalar extension comparisons with their unit normalizations. Construct p and z explicitly from the existing canonical direct-image coefficient comparisons, and use the normalized coefficient square for their compatibility equation.

Prove the literal beta transpose identity by the two mate counit equations and the scalar mate unit equation. The canonical direct-image comparison is its geometric mate by the coefficient-change adjunction theorem.

Construct s and t by composing the restriction, scalar and direct-image comparisons. Apply injectivity of the scalar Hom equivalence. The X unit normalization, the direct-image square, and naturality of p and d identify the two transposes. Finally transport the input from restriction along the composite ring map to the prescribed inverseObject using the restriction composition isomorphism and naturality of beta.

theorem completedScalarMateCoefficientTransport
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) [IsIso (completedCoefficientMap f d)]
    (SY : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (SX : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (φY : pbcAdicCompletion Y d ⟶ SY) (φX : pbcAdicCompletion X d ⟶ SX)
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj SY ≅ SX)
    (hc : completedCoefficientMap f d ≫ φX =
      (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map φY ≫ c.hom)
    (F : pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d) ⥤ pbcModules Y (pbcAdicCompletion Y d))
    [F.Additive]
    (hF : F = proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage f (pbcAdicCompletion Y d)
      (pbcAdicCompletion X d) (asIso (completedCoefficientMap f d)))
    (G : pbcModules X SX ⥤ pbcModules Y SY) [G.Additive]
    (hG : G = proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage f SY SX c)
    (i : pbcRestrict φX ⋙ F ≅
      G ⋙ pbcRestrict φY)
    (hi : ∀ (M : pbcModules X SX) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ),
      HEq (fun x ↦ (i.hom.app M).val.app U x)
        (fun x : ((proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage f SY SX c).obj M).val.obj U ↦ x))
    (e : pbcDerivedRestrict φX ⋙ F.rightDerivedFunctor ≅
      G.rightDerivedFunctor ⋙ pbcDerivedRestrict φY)
    (he : ∀ C : CochainComplex (pbcModules X SX) ℤ,
      F.rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ
          (((pbcRestrict φX).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≫
        F.rightDerivedFunctor.map
          ((pbcRestrict φX).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app C) ≫
        e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex i.hom (.up ℤ)).app C) ≫
        (pbcRestrict φY).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app
          ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≫
        (pbcDerivedRestrict φY).map (G.rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ C))
    (K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d))) :
    let χ := (pbcCompletedComparison Y d).hom ≫ φY
    let K₀ := (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcCompletedComparison X d).hom).obj K
    let Kᵢ := CompletedProjection.inverseObject f d K₀
    ∃ (s : (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcCompletedComparison Y d).hom).obj
          ((pbcDerivedRestrict φY).obj
            ((pbcDerivedExtend φY).obj (F.rightDerivedFunctor.obj K))) ≅
        ((DerivedScalarMate.push f (PerfectProjection.ring d Y) ⋙
          proEtaleRingDerivedExtension χ) ⋙
          (DerivedScalarMate.restriction χ).mapDerivedCategory).obj Kᵢ)
      (t : (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcCompletedComparison Y d).hom).obj
          ((pbcDerivedRestrict φY).obj
            (G.rightDerivedFunctor.obj ((pbcDerivedExtend φX).obj K))) ≅
        ((proEtaleRingDerivedExtension (DerivedScalarMate.inverseMap f χ) ⋙
          DerivedScalarMate.push f SY) ⋙
          (DerivedScalarMate.restriction χ).mapDerivedCategory).obj Kᵢ),
      (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcCompletedComparison Y d).hom).map
          ((pbcDerivedRestrict φY).map
            (((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction φY).homEquiv _ _).symm
              (F.rightDerivedFunctor.map
                  ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction φX).unit.app K) ≫
                e.hom.app ((pbcDerivedExtend φX).obj K)))) ≫ t.hom =
        s.hom ≫ (DerivedScalarMate.restriction χ).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((DerivedScalarMate.beta f χ).app Kᵢ)
